policy: §51.3 — a finding at a blocking severity BLOCKS promotion. scripts/release/sbom.sh exits non-zero, so every caller in the release chain stops.
exception_contract: §62.2 P2 discipline. An exception is ONLY ever time-bound and owner-attributed: id, owner, reason, opened and expires are all REQUIRED, expires must be after opened and no more than 90 days later, and a malformed exception REFUSES this whole file rather than being silently ignored. An expired exception does not apply — the finding blocks again. Add `artifact` to scope an exception to one release artifact; omit it to cover every artifact.

exception_example.reason: not reachable from any shipped code path; upstream fix lands in <release>
